invariants.rationale: The method is an instance method and thus 'this' must not be null at method entry.
cache is accessed immediately for cache.getFont(), thus must not be null.
The method accesses cache.getFont() and calls methods on it.
The field 'style' is accessed as style.background and style.font, so must be non-null.
The field 'layout' is assigned to GlyphLayout layout = this.layout and used, so must be non-null.
